observations.coverageNote: Only tax paid directly by individuals. Tax withheld at source on wages and other income is reported in the 'Retido na Fonte' line (IRRF core), which mixes individuals and companies.
observations.caveat: Because most individual income tax is withheld, this core understates the importance of personal income taxation; see the IRRF core.
